correctness.rationale: Directly expand the original averaging and idempotency equations for a general linear map on the Heisenberg Lie algebra. Nondegeneracy forces center preservation. The c=0 isotropic-image case and c=1 nondegenerate symplectic orthogonal projection case are necessary and sufficient. A symplectic basis argument gives orbit transitivity, central shears kill the functional, symplectic-group stabilizers yield exact counts, and clopen rank loci give reduced smooth components. Complete small-prime-field original-identity testing is supplied and the checked scope is explicitly limited.
